cards.claim: Annick Bongers has been listed on the focus list for the NL Gendergap maintenance project.
cards.quote: This narrative delves into the intricate connection between Annick Bongers and the NL Gendergap maintenance project, a Dutch Wikimedia initiative dedicated to bridging the gender gap in online representation. In the early 2000s, Annick Bongers was already an established figure in the Belgian art scene, known for her provocative performances that challenged societal norms and conventions. As her career flourished, so did her online presence. It was during this time that the NL Gendergap maintenance project was taking shape, driven by a group of dedicated Wikipedians who recognized the glaring disparity in online representation between men and women. The project's focus was to identify and create content on notable women who had been overlooked or underrepresented on the Dutch-language Wikipedia. Annick Bongers, with her remarkable achievements in the performing arts, soon caught the attention of the NL Gendergap maintenance team. Her unique blend of artistic expression and feminist ideology made her an ideal candidate for the project's focus list. Evidence of Annick's inclusion on the focus list can be found in the project's archives, where her name appears alongside other notable women who have made significant contributions to their respective fields.
